name: redstone-item-placement
comment: The placement hooks only items reach (ItemBlock / ItemReed / ItemRedstone.onItemUse, WP-2.6): a standing player (yaw 90) uses a torch (50) on each side face and the top of a stone block at (3, 61, 0) (BlockTorch.onBlockPlaced orients toward the clicked face), a redstone torch (76) on the -z face, a lever (69) on the platform top (BlockLever.onBlockPlaced: 5 + World.rand.nextInt(2)) and on the block's +z face, a button (77) on the block's -x face and on the platform top (BlockButton.canPlaceBlockOnSide refuses), a repeater item (356) on the platform (BlockRedstoneRepeater.onBlockPlacedBy: facing from the player's yaw) and redstone (331) next to it.
